question: Does one shared residual-context direction learned from three confirmed circuit heads predict the restricted checkpoint map of the omitted fourth head?
evidence_status: Prospective zero-forward stability screen. The opened gauge audit shows pairwise leading-context projector overlap 0.939--0.982 and median full context-Gram similarity 0.92455, but no leave-one-head-out common projector, omitted-head captured energy, random-direction comparison, or common-direction removal result has been computed.

searched: v23 occupied-reader writer grouping and gauge audit
P7 subspace-to-weight translation plan and 23:26 mathematical review
prior_art.novelty: The prior gauge audit compares independently fitted per-head directions. This screen instead learns one rank-one physical context projector from three maps and tests it on the omitted head, so a pooled optimum cannot hide a sacrificed component.
prior_art.known_lessons: A common leading direction does not imply a common complete map, semantic rank, causal use, or compression. Independent head-private coordinates are gauges. Random matched-rank directions and common-core removal are required, and no outcome may select a higher rank.

frozen_design.maps: Use the four immutable occupied-reader-contracted maps M_h with shape 1152x128 for L8H1, L9H1, L9H4, and L11H3.
frozen_design.component_weights: Equal physical Frobenius weight. No head, task, width, or outcome weighting.
frozen_design.leave_one_out: For each head h, fit the exact top rank-one context projector to the horizontal concatenation of the other three maps and report the omitted map's captured Frobenius-energy fraction.
frozen_design.gauge_check: Apply four seed-2308 independent 128x128 orthogonal private-coordinate rotations and require every held-out score and physical projector to agree.
frozen_design.random_control: For each held-out map, compare its learned-projector capture with the q99 of 256 seed-2401 isotropic rank-one physical-context projectors.
frozen_design.removal: Fit the rank-one projector to all four maps, remove it, and recompute median pairwise context-Gram similarity on the four private tails.

predictions.pred_a_authority_shapes_replay_certifica: All immutable hashes and 4x1152x128 shapes match; pooled reconstruction, SVD optimum certificates, private-gauge invariance, stored raw Gram replay, finiteness, and literal zero-forward price pass.
predictions.pred_b_rank1_context_core_predicts_every: Every leave-one-head-out projector captures at least 0.05 of its omitted map's energy and exceeds that map's fixed isotropic-random q99.
predictions.pred_c_three_head_fits_identify_one_stab: Every pair of the four leave-one-head-out physical projectors has squared overlap at least 0.85.
predictions.pred_d_removing_the_common_direction_red: Removing the pooled rank-one core lowers median pairwise context-Gram similarity by at least 0.05.

opposing_predictions.shared_rank1_trunk_plus_private_structur: A--D pass. One weight-defined physical context direction transfers across all four heads and explains a material part of their shared Gram geometry.
opposing_predictions.shared_leading_direction_inside_broader_: A--C pass and D fails. A stable rank-one trunk exists but does not account for most cross-head context similarity.
opposing_predictions.pairwise_alignment_without_universal_tra: A passes and B or C fails. The pairwise leading overlaps do not define one universally predictive rank-one core.
opposing_predictions.instrument_failure: A fails; no scientific score is interpreted.

null: A failure invalidates the screen. With valid A, any B or C failure rejects a universal rank-one shared-context capability. D failure rejects the claim that this direction explains a material share of the broad common Gram geometry.
decision: This is a checkpoint-capability screen only. It selects no higher rank, changes no causal bar, and cannot license adoption. A--C may nominate the frozen rank-one core for common-core/private-tail intervention only after the dominant downstream reader is identified; failure preserves the four private maps and redirects no live GPU work.
